mapper.sql: CASE WHEN c.first_publish_date IS NULL THEN '未发布' WHEN c.validity_period = '长期有效' THEN '长期有效' WHEN c.validity_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN '已过期' WHEN c.validity_end_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30 THEN '30 天内到期' ELSE '有效' END
mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, e.employee_name AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.course_id = c.id AND r.deleted = FALSE) AS review_round, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_demand_course rc WHERE rc.course_id = c.id) AS has_demand FROM biz_course c LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.employee_no = c.owner_no AND e.deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY c.${sortColumn} ${sortDirection} NULLS LAST, c.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
